scope_notes: Public BooleanUnion commands ran at idle in an empty owned document on private Xvfb. No proprietary implementation was inspected.
The first recipe measured fresh private-scheme defaults; remaining recipes seeded explicit defaults using separate owned geometry.
Snapshots record EndCommand result, geometry measures and polygon face regions, selection, source IDs, attributes, groups, geometry user text, undo/redo, cancellation and remembered options.
Successful open-surface and edge-only nonmanifold outputs are retained as unsupported kernel counterexamples. Internal coplanar face ownership and face/edge table order are not claimed equivalent.
